note: IP-neutral. Issue #269: a planet's party barge, a big barge floating over the sand that is one long party, a franchise of the town's cantina club. These are the defaults every barge shares; a planet has one only if its own file (content/core/planets/<id>.json) has a "barge" block, which gives it a name, its boss, a home spot, and may override anything here. The cantina's band ('band', in 'band_look') plays the planet's club music on the top deck and a DJ plays the lower deck's little rave; the crowd dances on every deck, steerage included, and never stops. Buy it from the boss or beat him, and it is yours (WorldState flag barge_owned_<planet id>). #269 cleanup: drive it from the control panel at the stern: dial a course, engage, and it goes on autopilot ('drive') while you walk about; it stops dead when it runs into anything, and blows up if it runs into the beast (going faster than 'beast_min_speed'), hurting anyone aboard by 'blast_damage' and coming back at home after 'rebuild_s' seconds of play. Everyone on board has 'person_hp', never fights back, never changes your standing, and is back after 'respawn_s' seconds of play. Read by src/systems/world/party_barge.gd; the look is src/systems/world/barge_look.gd.
name: the party barge

colors.note: Flat colours for each finish without the look layer (use_look off). With it, barge_look.gd paints them: rusted plates, wood planks, solar panels.

talk: {boss}: Welcome aboard {name}! Nobody stops dancing on MY barge.
{boss}: You want my barge? {price} credits. Or try and take it, little one.
{boss}: Hah! Look at you. Have a drink. Have three.
{boss}: Same band as the cantina, same drinks, better view. I own the franchise.
lines.bought: {boss} snatches your credits and waddles below deck to keep partying. {name} is yours.
lines.boss_beaten: {boss} tumbles below deck, still laughing. {name} is yours.
lines.console_locked: The panel is the boss's. Buy the barge or take it.
lines.console: Course: {course}    [A/D] Turn the course   [W] Engage autopilot   [E] Step away
lines.console_under_way: Autopilot on, course: {course}    [A/D] Turn the course   [S] All stop   [E] Step away
lines.engaged: Autopilot engaged. {name} swings round onto its course.
lines.all_stop: All stop. {name} slows to a halt.
lines.let_go: You step away from the panel. The party goes on.
lines.let_go_cruising: You step away from the panel. {name} keeps its course; the party goes on.
lines.blocked: {name} grinds to a dead stop against something. Set a new course.
lines.exploded: {name} hits the beast and goes up in a fireball!
